name: Rajasthan Heritage Tour
summary: The classic three-city royal circuit in seven days: Jaipur's Amber Fort and bazaars, Jodhpur's Mehrangarh above the Blue City, and Udaipur's lake palaces — paced with two nights in each city so the forts get mornings and the bazaars get evenings.
highlights: Amber Fort at opening time, before the crowds
Mehrangarh Fort rampart walk over the Blue City
Sunset boat ride on Lake Pichola, Udaipur
Folk-dance dinner and old-city bazaar evenings

itinerary.title: Arrive Jaipur
itinerary.description: Pickup and check-in, first look at the Hawa Mahal facade, evening in the walled city's bazaars.

itinerary.title: Amber Fort & City Palace
itinerary.description: Amber Fort at opening (Sheesh Mahal before the queues), Jaipur City Palace and Jantar Mantar after lunch, thali dinner with folk performance.

itinerary.title: To Jodhpur
itinerary.description: Travel to Jodhpur, evening around the clock-tower market at Sardar Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Mehrangarh & the Blue City
itinerary.description: Morning at Mehrangarh Fort and its museum, walk the indigo lanes below, then set off toward Udaipur — with an optional stop at the Ranakpur Jain temple en route.

itinerary.title: Udaipur City Palace
itinerary.description: The full City Palace complex above Lake Pichola, old-town ghats and rooftop dinner.

itinerary.title: Lakes & lanes
itinerary.description: Sunset boat ride on Lake Pichola past the Lake Palace, free time in Udaipur's artisan lanes.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast with a lake view, transfer for departure.
